title: Fenwick's Flights of Fancy: Fully Fledged
description: This project takes the wondrous highs of exploring The Aether dimension and adds the magical spice of Ars Nouveau with a dash of the latest version of update with The Copper Age Backport.
body:
Fenwick's Flights of Fancy: Fully Fledged is a remastering of my pack of a similar name now containing Ars Nouveau to increase the whimsy by at least 42%.

Take to the skies through a portal of glowstone and water that many in their younger years failed to recreate with the star of this pack The Aether, and find floating cities centered on floating cathedrals with the help of Aether Villages while snacking on themed cuisine with Aether's Delight.

Harness the powers of the arcane for your own will with Ars Nouveau and refuel your efforts with the add-on Ars Nouveau's Flavors & Delight.

Keep any item at arm's reach with Traveler's Backpack as you make your way to challenge the wizard's tower in the plains to prove yourself the better mage.
